_doc: Respellings applied to (already cleaned) station / destination names before TTS. Keys are whole words or phrases (case-sensitive, longest match first, matched on word boundaries). Values are plain respellings or text containing [[IPA]] segments, which the front end in speech.py passes straight to the voice as phonemes (written in RP-style espeak IPA; converted automatically for the 'en' dialect voice). Cleaning rules that run BEFORE this table (see speech.clean_name): '(Circle)/(Bakerloo)/(H&C)/(D&P)/(Central)' [+ ' Line'] are dropped, other '(X)' -> 'X', '&' -> 'and', 'St.' -> 'Saint', '-' -> ' '. E.g. 'Edgware Road (Circle)' -> 'Edgware Road', 'Hammersmith (H&C)' -> 'Hammersmith', 'Paddington (H&C)' -> 'Paddington', 'Shepherd's Bush (Central)' -> 'Shepherd's Bush', 'Kensington (Olympia)' -> 'Kensington Olympia', 'Heathrow Terminals 2 & 3' -> 'Heathrow Terminals 2 and 3', "King's Cross St. Pancras" -> "King's Cross Saint Pancras".
